UNILATERAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Non-Disclosure Agreement (the “Agreement”) is entered into as of {{effectiveDate}} (the “Effective Date”) by and between {{partyA.name}}, {{partyA.entityType}} (“Discloser”), and {{partyB.name}}, {{partyB.entityType}} (“Recipient”). Discloser and Recipient are each a “Party” and together the “Parties.”

1. Purpose

Discloser will share confidential information with Recipient for the purpose of {{purpose}} (the “Purpose”). Disclosure under this Agreement is one-way; Recipient discloses nothing to Discloser in confidence.

2. Confidential Information

“Confidential Information” means non-public information disclosed by Discloser to Recipient, in any form, that is marked confidential or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential from its nature or the circumstances of disclosure.

3. Exclusions

Confidential Information does not include information that: (a) is or becomes public through no act of Recipient; (b) Recipient held without obligation of confidence before disclosure; (c) Recipient receives from a third party free to disclose it; or (d) Recipient independently develops without use of or reference to the Confidential Information.

4. Obligations

Recipient will use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose, protect it with at least reasonable care, and disclose it only to personnel and advisers who need it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations no less protective than these. Recipient is responsible for any breach by those recipients.

5. Compelled Disclosure

Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by law or court order, provided it gives Discloser prompt notice where legally permitted and reasonable assistance in seeking protective treatment.

6. Term

This Agreement runs for {{termYears}} years from the Effective Date. Confidentiality obligations survive for {{confidentialityYears}} years after each disclosure, and indefinitely for trade secrets for as long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.

7. Return or Destruction

On Discloser’s written request, Recipient will return or destroy Confidential Information in its possession, except for copies retained in routine backups or as required by law, which remain subject to this Agreement.

8. No Licence, No Obligation

No licence or other right in Confidential Information is granted except as expressly set out here. Nothing in this Agreement obliges either Party to enter into any further transaction.

9. Remedies

Unauthorised disclosure may cause harm for which damages are inadequate. Discloser may seek injunctive relief in addition to any other remedy, without the need to post bond.

Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governingLaw}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules.

Entire Agreement

This Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties on its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions. It may be amended only in a writing signed by both Parties. It may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original.

Execution

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
